verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line saying BVNK lets customers 'put idle balances to work with built-in rewards', which confirms a rewards program exists but documents none of its economics. Nothing in the pack covers reserve composition or attestations for held stablecoins. Missing for 10: reserve composition disclosure, attestation reports, rewards/yield rate mechanics, eligibility criteria, plainly stated regulatory caveats, independent corroboration.
